release.description: Adds commit-act command tools and act-aware guidance processing while improving web-function handling, tool reliability, and provider integrations.
release.action: Command Tools: Enabled command tools for the commit act.
Guidance Processing: Added support metadata to limit guidance tools to act-processing contexts.
Web Functions: Improved response processing, request logging, and file-based URL handling.
Command and File Tools: Improved parameter handling and runtime error reporting.
Episode Processing: Corrected the move_to_episode tool behavior.
Provider and Integration Processing: Streamlined Anthropic provider processing and simplified related provider, reviewer, and integration code.
Tooling: Cleaned up AI file processor and function-tool implementations.

release.description: Improves function tools, guidance processing, error reporting, CLI handling, and logging configurations.
release.action: Function Tools: Added file-listing capabilities to the function tools.
Guidance Processing: Improved guidance processing and support for process context during file processing.
Guidance Processing: Fixed guidance processor instruction handling.
Command Tools: Improved command-tool process error reporting.
Ghostwriter CLI: Corrected Ghostwriter CLI help and console prompt behavior.
Logging: Improved thread-count logging and default-model logging.
Logging: Adjusted the Machai logging level.
Parameter Processing: Normalized parameter placeholder handling for cleaner and more consistent configuration resolution.

release.description: Enhances Bindex tooling, configuration handling, and project automation capabilities while improving reliability across workflows.
release.action: Act and Configuration Enhancements: Implemented support for episode parameters.
Act and Configuration Enhancements: Implemented default property value processing for act configuration sections.
Act and Configuration Enhancements: Added fallback and mutable configurator support for more flexible runtime configuration.

Function Tool Execution: Fixed get_recursive_file_list, tool calls through ToolsProvider, perform_act result returns, load_act_details, path parameter naming, return values, end-task handling, act lookup diagnostics, and log chunk naming.
Runtime Reliability: Fixed model override handling, asynchronous act and guidance execution, stacktrace output, request session parameter naming, web content fetching, and error handling behavior.
